referee_caveats_inferred: Heavy reliance on optically thin LTE with Tex = T_CMB for non-CO species; no per-species uncertainty on this assumption
N(HCO+) used as the H2 proxy with a single abundance; CO-poor conclusions depend on it and on circular use of N(HCO+) on both axes of CO/HCO+
Extraction of the normalized spectrum from a dirty-map peak is not described in enough detail to check systematics (continuum level, beam dilution, resolved QSO structure)
Narrow/broad component split is admitted to be unclear (line width histogram not bimodal) yet used as a headline result
RADEX results depend on fixed Tk = 50 K and degenerate X(CO)/(dv/dr); inconsistent 4e-6 in text versus 2.6e-6 in the table for Subcomponent 5-1
Many correlation conclusions rest on a mix of this work and heterogeneous literature data

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Several hundred GB of raw ALMA data across 33 projects (calibrator scans only; much smaller if only calibrator fields are retrieved)
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public and equations are given, but the extraction of spectra, the archival data selection, the fitting procedure and the integration windows are under-specified, so the numeric tables could not be reproduced without the authors' scripts.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public data and numeric results exist, but the spectrum extraction, fitting and velocity-window recipe is incomplete and spans 33 projects.
